source_verification.PhotoCropper.tsx: Present at /app/frontend/src/components/PhotoCropper.tsx. Named export + default export confirmed. Renders <Modal> with GestureDetector wrapping Gesture.Simultaneous(Pan, Pinch). Circular viewport uses borderRadius = CROP_SIZE/2. Header has Cancel + 'Use photo' TouchableOpacity elements with data-testid={`${testID}-cancel`} and {`${testID}-confirm`}. Confirm handler calls expo-image-manipulator.manipulateAsync with computed crop math then onConfirm(result.uri). Note: RN <TouchableOpacity> does not forward `data-testid` DOM attribute; RN's automation prop is `testID`. Not a runtime bug on native, but source uses `data-testid` as specified in the review request — flagged as a low-priority code-review note only.
source_verification.trainee_profile: app/trainee/(tabs)/profile.tsx: PhotoCropper import ✅, cropperUri state ✅, pickImage sets allowsEditing:false + calls setCropperUri ✅, commitCroppedPhoto async handler ✅, <PhotoCropper testID='trainee-profile-cropper' ...> mounted ✅. No FileSystem call inside pickImage.
source_verification.no_native_os_crop: None of the 4 wiring files call launchImageLibraryAsync with allowsEditing:true or aspect:[1,1]. All use allowsEditing:false + quality:1.
source_verification._layout_gesture_root: app/_layout.tsx line 143 wraps app tree in <GestureHandlerRootView style={{flex:1}}> — required by PhotoCropper's Gesture Handler.

backend_regression.coverage: POST /api/trainee-profiles + POST /api/trainer-profiles — device-local URI rejection (file://, content://, ph://, assets-library://) still 400s; valid data:image/png;base64,... payload (equivalent to what PhotoCropper's manipulator output + readAsStringAsync produces) persists and syncs to GET profile + GET /api/auth/me for both roles.

critical_code_review_comments: PhotoCropper.tsx uses `data-testid` attribute on <TouchableOpacity>. React Native does not forward `data-testid` — it uses `testID` (capital ID). On native the automation prop will be silently dropped and Cancel/Use-photo buttons won't be locatable by Detox/Maestro/appium. Recommend switching to `testID={`${testID || 'photo-cropper'}-cancel`}` (and -confirm). Only web/Expo-web renders the `data-testid` DOM attr — mobile targets won't. Since this is a mobile-first Expo RN app per the review request, this is a minor testability regression to address before mobile e2e is wired up.

PhotoCropper renders its own <GestureHandlerRootView> INSIDE a <Modal>, in addition to the app-level one in _layout.tsx. This is actually correct/needed on Android because Modal is a separate native view hierarchy — good defensive design, keep as-is.
